gaps.originalGap: Four API projections were not joined for the row.
gaps.resolution: Added api/versionHistory.ts to join versions, ledger rows, component test reports, and adoptions once per component query.

gaps.originalGap: The existing DataTable did not own the expanded version anatomy.
gaps.resolution: VersionRow owns the expanded content and is rendered as the DataTable cell composition.

gaps.originalGap: The page had a hand-rolled VersionDiffViewer despite a library DiffViewer asset.
gaps.resolution: Deleted the page viewer and composed the published DiffViewer with the version diff response.

gaps.originalGap: Test artifacts use report references rather than CaptureGrid cells.
gaps.resolution: Mapped version-scoped screenshot/story-sheet artifacts to CaptureCell and show an honest absence when no usable reference exists.

gaps.originalGap: The old list had no bounded long-history rendering strategy.
gaps.resolution: Uses the published VirtualList asset for histories over 50 rows and DataTable otherwise.
